answer: When the panel doubts all else, Falconer merlin proof flown at the aerie still holds, and it holds on each merlin is a measured quarry yield plus a falconer's signature. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the echo is the pass, the haven is the fare, the ember is the stamp — and stamps are never sold at any price. The proof is checked where it was made; the applicant's story about the place counts for nothing. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 32 per proof, 11392 for 356, owed every epoch with no exception. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
